verdict.rationale: vLLM is an open-source inference engine installed via uv/pip, built from source, or run as a Docker image. Products of this kind can plausibly offer a hosted cloud tier, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains nothing about a vendor-hosted cloud offering, pricing tiers, rate limits, or usage caps.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know the pricing tiers, rate limits, and usage caps that apply when offloading inference to the vendor's hosted cloud tier
